value.rationale: For a natural explicit randomized Runge–Kutta solver, the exact optimal temporal dependence is nontrivial (opposite magnitudes rather than opposite uniform stages) and extends scalar mean-square stability beyond the classic midpoint endpoint, under unchanged per-stage uniform marginals and two evaluations per time step. This supplies a sharp motivated numerical stability benchmark, not an arbitrary coefficient exercise.
